verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX developer page says the Blackwell Transformer Engine accelerates AI development "across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch". The CUDA Toolkit and NGC containers give an official software base, and community Llama.cpp and Phoronix CUDA benchmarks show ML/compute workloads running on the 5090. However, the pack contains no officially documented PyTorch builds or framework support matrix naming the RTX 5090. Missing for 10: official PyTorch/framework support matrix listing the RTX 5090 or Blackwell consumer GPUs, documented framework build/version requirements (e.g., minimum CUDA/PyTorch versions), independent hands-on confirmation of PyTorch/TensorFlow running on the card.
